# sonrai_account_disabled_service (Resource)

Disables a cloud service in one account, denying its sensitive permissions.

A service already disabled -- from the console, or by another configuration -- is rejected rather than adopted; import it instead.

This resource claims only the service it names. To declare the complete set of disabled services for an account, use `sonrai_account_disabled_services_authoritative`.

Creating this resource *stages* the change. It takes effect only once the pending changes for the containing root scope are submitted and deployed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Disable a service in one account. Claims only this service; anything else
# disabled in the account is left alone.
resource "sonrai_account_disabled_service" "cloud9_prod" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
  control_key = "cloud9"
}

# To cover several accounts, list each one.
resource "sonrai_account_disabled_service" "cloud9_sandbox" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "210987654321"
  control_key = "cloud9"
}

output "cloud9_prod" {
  value = {
    scope   = sonrai_account_disabled_service.cloud9_prod.scope
    status  = sonrai_account_disabled_service.cloud9_prod.status
    pending = sonrai_account_disabled_service.cloud9_prod.pending
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_key` (String) Firewall control key for the service, for example `s3`, `ec2` or `sagemaker`.
- `resource_id` (String) Cloud-native id of the account to disable the service in: an AWS account id, a GCP project id, or an Azure subscription id. Give ids bare; `my-project` resolves the same as `projects|my-project`.

Organizational units, folders, management groups and roots are not accepted. List the member accounts individually.
- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the form `control_key@root_scope@resource_id`.
- `pending` (Boolean) True while this control has a staged change that has not been submitted and deployed.
- `scope` (String) Canonical scope path this resolved to, recomputed on every read.
- `status` (String) Control status reported by the platform: `Disabled`, `Protected`, `Unprotected` or `Non-Privileged`. Reads `Disabled` from the moment a block is staged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is control_key@root_scope@resource_id.
terraform import sonrai_account_disabled_service.cloud9_prod 'cloud9@aws/r-abcd@123456789012'
```
